title: Classify mixed-sign orthogonal phase defects at every width (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration. For any fixed binary sign mask b, the complete phase-defect image of orthogonal binary chart changes is

```text
D_b = {e : wt(b+e) == wt(b) mod 4}
T_e = I + e e^T
S = T_(d_b(S)) H, with d_b(H)=0
```

Every attainable defect has that single-transvection representative and an equal-size fiber. The exact-preserver subgroup has order `|O(n,2)| / sum_{k == wt(b) mod 4} binomial(n,k)` for every positive width. At width six with one negative axis there are 12 defects and 1920 exact preservers; the cited equal-sign case has 16 and 1440. No new kappa, physical supplier or selected-frontier change is claimed.

This extends Philipp / mightyOil #1300 to arbitrary fixed mixed signs. Gareth Davidson #1255 supplies the C-gate phase contract and row convention; yssite #1558 supplies signed Gauss-normalization context, following icekylinx #24. Their results are cited premises, not audit deliverables. Classical quadratic-refinement and Gauss-sum methods retain their classical status. The proof, verifier and exact source pins occupy six new files in `research/mixed-sign-phase-spectrum/`.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19146049). Canonical main was refreshed before submission and remains `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`, priority 7. The bit-helper-contract card is explicitly changed to this phase-boundary side result.

## Evidence

Before, the equal-sign spectrum requires defect weight divisible by four. After, the exact mixed-sign criterion permits a weight-two defect for the width-five one-negative-axis fixture and excludes some equal-sign candidates.

The generated source-bound receipts pass and agree in normal and optimized Python. They enumerate 777 orthogonal matrices, 23,866 matrix/sign pairs, 749,988 literal signed-kernel coefficients, 66,066 full binary matrices, 349,524 sign/defect candidates, 87,892 attaining representatives and 36,864 cocycle pairs. Ten semantic controls reject the named incorrect assumptions. Universal quantifiers rest on PROOF.md, not extrapolation from these finite domains.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12.15 and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/mixed-sign-phase-spectrum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/mixed-sign-phase-spectrum/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-sign-phase-spectrum
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/mixed-sign-phase-spectrum --check-source-history
```

Substitute any CPython 3.12 executable elsewhere. Expected markers are `PASS_MIXED_SIGN_PHASE_SPECTRUM`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Both registered checks were individually timed locally, at 3.08 and 3.09 seconds. Metadata/pins, exact committed bytes/source history, whitespace and static syntax/function-size inspection pass. No separate Python linter or type checker was available locally.

Official committed export and offline integrity checks pass. An optimized replay from a read-only Git-free export with empty executable PATH returns the identical receipt; all seven exported files remain unchanged. No predecessor executable is imported.

## Limitations

The algebraic contract fixes orthonormal active charts and the sign mask indexing their columns. Physical routes and frame costs, native realization, acquisition, dirty restoration, precision/tape, stock, complete supplier admission and a complete multiplication theorem remain unproved here. Lean, Docker and the selected supplier cold replay were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Bind a named mixed-sign native helper and price one exact-preserving chart with its complete transport/restoration invoice.
- Classify defects when allowed chart changes must fix specified literal axes. The unrestricted representative can violate that route constraint.

## Related open work

No open contribution found by the phase-spectrum searches computes this mixed-sign defect image or fiber count. Sparse local notes and unpublished work limit that search coverage.

- #5224 prices returned heterogeneous native-stage invoices; signed endpoint synthesis remains outside its price screen. This result supplies no native implementation or competing invoice.
- #3924 rebases an R439 helper shear and preserves its paid profile. It concerns a fixed dirty register word, rather than the signed orthogonal C-gate phase spectrum here.

No extra computations were run to check either contribution.
